d: When no one catches any fish in a fishing derby, the men of the lodge test the lake water and make a shocking discovery.
Bob buys a set of questionable golf clubs.
A shopping spree is the result of the purchase of a cordless drill.

A 2011 performance by comedian Steve Smith as his alter ego, handyman Red Green, who dispenses advice on life, love and happiness. Shot on location at: Casino Rama Entertainment Center - Orillia Ontario Canada, October 27th, 2011
Red and his pals experiment with various tactics to rustproof their vehicles.
Handyman shares gardening hacks, focusing on growing beer nuts and using an old car as a garden center.
The Lodge is a possible location candidate for the bi-annual Possum Olympics.
Women try to preserve history, Men try to make it. Camelot comes to Possum Lake.
Women are watching the world, Men are watching television. The men use the roof of a silo as a satellite dish.
The men of the Lodge receive 49 gas tanks.

Practical jokes are in the air at Possum Lodge as Red recounts Stinky Peterson's disastrous attempt to prank Old Man Sedgewick, which ends with a spectacular tumble into a septic tank. While Harold experiments with a new "electronic effects machine" to spice up the broadcast, Red hits the golf course to discuss Moose Thompson's latest invention: a high-powered water-skiing slingshot.
